name: claude-kit
description: Claude Code plugins for the things the built-in tooling leaves quiet: usage visibility, writing quality, and repo safety.

plugins.name: usage-bars
plugins.description: A multi-line status line showing your session and weekly rate limits alongside context window usage, as three aligned bars with percentages, reset countdowns, and a burn-rate projection.

plugins.name: linkedin-audit
plugins.description: Audit a LinkedIn profile from its "Save to PDF" export and write a section-by-section feedback report, using only facts the profile already states.
